dataset_metadata.name: CALCE PL Pouch Storage Study
dataset_metadata.institution: Center for Advanced Life Cycle Engineering (CALCE), University of Maryland
dataset_metadata.citation: CALCE. 'Storage Data and Test Description.' CALCE Battery Data, University of Maryland. https://calce.umd.edu/battery-data
dataset_metadata.funding: Supported by more than 150 companies and organizations supporting CALCE at the University of Maryland

cell_info.cell_notes: Same cell model (PL-325085-2C) used in the companion CALCE PL-Cyc dataset. Cell chemistry and capacity inferred from companion dataset documentation. Named 'PLN' cells in data files (e.g. PLN_51).

aging_modes.notes: Full factorial: 4 temperatures x 3 SOC levels = 12 unique conditions, 4 cells per condition, 144 cells total. The 144 cells are further divided into 3 groups of 48 by checkup frequency (every 3 weeks, every 3 months, every 6 months). Checkup consists of capacity test and/or impedance measurement.

time_protocol.notes: Storage intervals between checkups: 3 weeks, 3 months, or 6 months depending on group. No total test duration stated in available documents.

checkup.notes: Three checkup frequency groups: 48 cells every 3 weeks (capacity + impedance), 48 cells every 3 months (capacity + impedance), 48 cells every 6 months (capacity only). Interval field uses minimum stated interval (3 weeks). Checkup protocol: CCCV charge at C/2 (cutoff C/100), CC discharge at C/2 to measure capacity, then full charge + impedance test.

notes: Dataset label 'PL-Stor' distinguishes this storage dataset from the companion cycling dataset ('PL-Cyc') on the same cell type. No dedicated paper was found for this dataset; the web page (web.pdf) is the primary source. The data_url points to the general CALCE battery data page (anchor #CS2 shared with CS2 cylindrical cell data). has_rawdata is false because no continuous V/I/T timeseries during storage intervals is described; only periodic checkup measurements are recorded. recorded_variables and data_structure fields are inferred from the described checkup procedure and from the companion PL-Cyc dataset structure. Authors and year are not explicitly stated in the web description; year 2016 is inferred from folder naming.
